staticEvidence.methodology: Compile exact reviewed source with frozen F frontend. Find the shortest in-loop CFG path from a backward-jump target to that jump, counting each instruction once and calls as one. Multiply by required iterations. Ignore initialization, nested callback execution, arithmetic microsteps and final checks, making the bound optimistic. No guest source is executed. For nonempty some inputs, add the callback straight-line instruction path once per iteration; actual additional callback visits remain excluded.
